data.one_liner: Loads .env files and exposes variables to Dart, iOS and Android code.
data.what_it_does: Reads a .env file at app startup and makes each key/value pair accessible via FlutterConfig.get. Provides a test helper to inject values without a real .env file.
use_when: You need simple access to build‑time configuration values in Flutter code
You want the same variables available in native iOS/Android code
You prefer a lightweight plugin without code generation
avoid_when: You require encrypted or obfuscated secrets in the binary
You need a full‑featured configuration management system with remote overrides
strengths: Very small API, easy to use
Works on both Dart and native platforms
weaknesses: Secrets are not protected – must not store sensitive data
Only reads .env files; no runtime updates
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin, run FlutterConfig.loadEnvVariables() before runApp; iOS requires no extra steps, Android may need Gradle 4+
